# Vanilla & Somethin'

> Vanilla & Somethin' is an independent architecture and interior design studio based in Mangalore, Karnataka, India. The studio works across architectural design, interior design, landscape concepts, BIM and digital design, architectural visualisation and project support.

This file is supplementary machine-readable site navigation. It is not a substitute for the public HTML pages, and it is not a Google ranking signal. Use the linked pages as the canonical source for current project and service details.

## Studio and services

- [Homepage](https://www.vanillasometh.in/): Overview of the studio, its approach and selected work.
- [Architecture and interior design](https://www.vanillasometh.in/seo): Service overview, design process and project enquiry information.
- [Team](https://www.vanillasometh.in/team.html): Studio leadership and team.
- [Contact](https://www.vanillasometh.in/contact/): Project enquiry form and contact details.
- [Estimator](https://www.vanillasometh.in/estimator/): Preliminary project estimator.

## Location and regional pages

- [Mangalore](https://www.vanillasometh.in/locations/mangalore/): Studio base and architecture/interior design enquiries in Mangaluru and Dakshina Kannada.
- [Kasaragod](https://www.vanillasometh.in/locations/kasaragod/): Project enquiries in Kasaragod, subject to scope and site coordination.
- [Coastal Karnataka](https://www.vanillasometh.in/locations/coastal-karnataka/): Regional project enquiries across coastal Karnataka.
- [Kerala](https://www.vanillasometh.in/locations/kerala/): Regional project enquiries; includes a portfolio project listed in Kozhikode, Kerala.

## Portfolio

- [Project showcase](https://www.vanillasometh.in/project-showcase/): Selected residential, commercial and interior projects.
- [Nord Terra House](https://www.vanillasometh.in/project-showcase/nord-terra/): Residential project listed in Kozhikode, Kerala.

## Accuracy notes

The studio is based in Mangalore. A regional landing page indicates project enquiry coverage, not a staffed branch or registered office in that location. Travel, site visits and scope are agreed per project. Project locations above reflect the portfolio's own project records.
